description: Decodes a METAR aviation weather report into plain English: wind, visibility, weather, clouds, ceiling, temperature/dew point, altimeter and the VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR flight category. Pass either the raw METAR text or a 4-letter ICAO airport code to fetch the latest report from NOAA's Aviation Weather Center. For training, not for flight planning.

icao.description: ICAO airport code, e.g. KJFK. Used when metar is not given.

metar.description: Raw METAR/SPECI text, e.g. 'KJFK 261751Z 18012KT 10SM FEW250 24/14 A3002'.

name: decode_metar
title: Decode a METAR
